text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I'm still feeling anxious. Are you 
doing alright, Fine Motion...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Look, that's why I don't get being 
anxious. C'mon, let's just cheer them on. 
I'm sure our feelings will reach them."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Reach them or not, it's a thorny path 
either way. Fine, what is your answer—?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa. I'm getting butterflies!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Because if I don't run a race that leaves 
an impact, how will I stay in everyone's 
hearts?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So doing it normally won't cut it, right? 
Weaving back and forth all over the track! 
...Or should I do something crazy like 
that?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I understand. I will do nothing to 
diminish the dignity of the race!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's also true that nothing comes 
to mind. What should I do, I wonder...?”
choice_data_list:
Just keep doing things the way you have 
been.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If it's like usual, I'd just enjoy it 
normally, you know?
choice_data_list: Just give it your all and have fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Simply by enjoying herself, she captivated 
countless fans and gave dreams to other 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She already has more than enough shock 
value; what needs to change is the 
direction of her feelings— Something polar 
opposite to "please don't end."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you say the funniest things!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then shall we give it a try? Not just 
praying... right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna carve my running... deep into 
everyone's hearts with a smash!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Like roughly chopped onions, with maximum 
intensity!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Chop it right up~!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Eep...!? F-Fine-san...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, did I startle you? I was just 
getting myself pumped up again.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm a Fine Motion with a different 
flavor. I hope you enjoy it too, Rob 
Roy-chan.
